hooks.name: Activate venv for new terminal instances

action.prompt: This project uses a Python virtual environment at `venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1`. You are starting a new terminal instance. Activate the venv for this terminal session before running project commands, e.g. begin the command with `& venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1;` so that Python, pip, pytest, and installed packages resolve to the project environment. Alternatively invoke tools directly via `venv\Scripts\python.exe` or `venv\Scripts\pytest.exe`.
